newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Korea First Bank US$100 mln FRN group.
newsitem.headline: Korea First Bank US$100 mln FRN group.

text.p: A group has formed for Korea First Bank's three-year US$100 million floating rate notes issue, arranger Chase Manhattan Asia said on Thursday. The notes were issued at par and reoffered at a fixed 99.865. They pay a coupon of 35 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
Fees are 25.5 basis points for all levels, giving an all-in return of 43.5 basis points.
Six banks in addition to the arranger joined the syndication.
IBJ Asia is the senior co-lead manager.
Co-lead managers are CITIC Industrial Bank and PaineWebber.
Co-managers are BW Bank, Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley.
Signing is set for December 18. The payment date is December 27.
